James P. Sullivan

Republican candidate for Supreme Court, Place 2 (unexpired term), Texas

Justice, Supreme Court of Texas (Place 2); attorney

James P. Sullivan is a Republican justice on the Supreme Court of Texas. Gov. Greg Abbott appointed him to Place 2 in January 2025 to fill the seat Jimmy Blacklock left when he became chief justice; before that, Sullivan was Abbott's general counsel. He ran unopposed in the March 3, 2026 Republican primary and faces Democrat Chari Kelly on November 3, 2026, for the rest of the unexpired term.

Where Sullivan stands

Judicial opinions and access to the courts
Says judicial opinions should be accessible and readable for ordinary Texans, not just lawyers.

Background

  • Justice, Supreme Court of Texas, Place 2 (appointed January 2025 to present)
  • General Counsel to Gov. Greg Abbott (2021–2025)
  • Deputy General Counsel to Gov. Greg Abbott
  • Assistant Solicitor General, Office of the Texas Attorney General
  • Law clerk, U.S. Court of Appeals for the D.C. Circuit
  • Litigator in private practice
  • Grew up in the Austin area (Westlake High School)
  • B.A., Rice University
  • J.D., Harvard Law School
  • Won the March 3, 2026 Republican primary unopposed
